title: : BE OF GOOD CHEER!
verse: “For as he thinketh in his heart.” (KJV) Pro 23:7
body: : BE OF GOOD CHEER! “For as he thinketh in his heart.” (KJV) Pro 23:7 The power resident in positive thinking is unparalleled - unmatched - in its extraordinary capacity to transform man. The power of good thinking and excellent attitude are two of the most high-rankng qualities a person can have to change his life. “Summing it all up, friends, I'd say you'll do best by filling your minds and meditating on things true, noble, reputable, authentic, compelling, gracious - the best, not the worst; the beautiful, not the ugly; things to praise, not things to curse. Put into practice what you learned from me, what you heard and saw and realized. Do that, and God, who makes everything work together, will work you into his most excellent harmonies” (TBCL) Phil 4:8-9. What you believe controls you and your destiny ultimately. “Nothing truly stops you. Nothing truly holds you back. For your own will is always within your control. Sickness may challenge your body. But are you merely your body? Lameness may impede your legs. But you are not merely your legs. Your will is bigger than your legs. Your will needn’t be affected by an incident unless you let it.”
prayer: Spend quality time in prayers as led.

title: : YOU’VE GOT TO THINK FOR WARD TO GO FOR WARD!
body: : YOU’VE GOT TO THINK FOR WARD TO GO FOR WARD! “. but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.” (KJV)) Rom 12:2 To deal with wrong behavior, deal with wrong thinking. Our minds like computers - can only bring out of them what we put into them. If you want to have a better life, you need to have a better thinking. Satan knows if he can succeed in dominating our thinking, he can dominate our life and determine how far we go in life. “Do not be conformed to this world (this age), [fashioned after and adapted to its external, superficial customs], but be transformed (changed) by the [entire] renewal of your mind [by its new ideals and its new attitude].” (AMP) Rom 12:2. Casting out evil thought is instantaneous but staying free is a lifetime work. “Don't become like the people of this world. Instead, change the way you think. Then you will always be able to determine what God really wants - what is good, pleasing, and perfect” (GWT) Rom 12:2. I leave you with the earnest prayer of Paul, 1 Thes 5:23.
confession: And the very God of peace sanctify [me] wholly; and I pray God [my] whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of Christ.

title: : THE MAN GOES WHERE THE MIND GOES
body: : THE MAN GOES WHERE THE MIND GOES “And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may. not be ashamed before him at his coming” (KJV) 1 John 2:28 Many years back, Louise Armstrong sang, “We are traveling in the footsteps, Of those who've gone before, But we'll all be reunited (but if we stand reunited), On a new and sunlit shore (then a new world is in store). Oh when the Saints go marching in, When the Saints go marching in, O Lord, I want to be in that number, When the Saints go marching in. And when the sun refuses to shine, And when the sun refuses to shine, O Lord, I want to be in that number, When the Saints go marching in.” “But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only” (KJV) Matt 24:36. Go through this verse thoughtfully, 1 Thes 5:2. Two things to be done: 1. Live as a child of the Light; avoid all works of darkness 2. Be spiritually awake and alive unto God - soberness should characterize your life, Matt 24:44.
prayer: [Sing the Hymn: When The Roll Is Called Up Yonder] Heavenly Father, thank You for reminding me of the coming of Christ. I pray for grace to keep myself holy and watchful for His coming in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : HE’S COMING BACK SOON
verse: because the source of your life flows from it”
body: : HE’S COMING BACK SOON “Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from it” (GWT) Pro 4:23 Taking control of our thoughts is so essential to life and godliness. “Above all else, guard your heart, for it is the wellspring of life.” If you’ve to be in control - protect and watch over your heart - just like a watchdog does to the house. Your thoughts influence and finally determine your overall destiny. Everything - success and failure, prosperity and poverty, life and death - originates from the heart. If you must last the distance, there are personal covenants you have to make in different areas of life so as to remain on the track. Here are some biblical recommendations for taking control of our hearts and getting rid of wrong thoughts: 1. Dwell in the Word and live by the same, Col 3:16 2. Select what you feed your mind with on TV, internet and via numerous social media - avoid those things that will promote sinning against, Rom 13:14. Above all, live a life of total dependence on the Holy Spirit - let Him guide you daily - Read Matt 26:33-75.
prayer: Holy Spirit, be the LORD over my heart. [Deal with the root of negative and filthy thoughts.]

title: : AVOIDING NEGA TIVE AND FIL THY THOUGHTS
verse: quite small and won't last.” (TLB) 2 Cor 4:17
body: : AVOIDING NEGA TIVE AND FIL THY THOUGHTS “These troubles and sufferings of ours are, after all, quite small and won't last.” (TLB) 2 Cor 4:17 When life hits you hard - don’t give in - hold on to your faith. Let me remind you of the story behind the song “I Have Decided to Follow Jesus.” About 150 years ago, One Welsh missionary converted a family in North-East India in a community that was quite primitive and aggressive. After the man’s conversion, many accepted Christianity. The chief summoned all the villagers and asked the man to renounce his faith or face execution. Moved by the Holy Spirit, the man sang, “I have decided to follow Jesus (3 times). No turning back, no turning back.” The chief, in his fury, ordered his two children to be arrowed down. The chief asked again, “. deny your faith or lose your wife too.” He sang in reply, “Though no one joins me, still I will follow.” His wife was arrowed down. “I will give you one more opportunity to deny your faith and live.” In the face of death the man sang, “The cross before me, the world behind me.” He was shot dead. But after their deaths, a miracle took place. The chief, moved by the faith of the man, gave his life to Jesus and the whole villagers.
prayer: Father, I’ll hold on matter what, Amen.

title: : HOLD ON TO YOUR F AITH
body: : HOLD ON TO YOUR F AITH “Casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you” (NKJV) 1 Pet 5:7 No one cares more - not even you - about your life like God does. You’re always on His mind thinking about you night and day. Your concerns are His concerns, Ps 55:22. Throw your worries, fear and anxieties on God. He will carry it all for you and sustain you [Read Matt 6:25-26]. No need carrying what God can carry for you. Let Him be your succor. “What a friend we have in Jesus, All our sins and griefs to bear! What a privilege to carry, Everything to God in prayer! Oh, what peace we often forfeit, Oh, what needless pain we bear, All because we do not carry, Everything to God in prayer! Have we trials and temptations? Is there trouble anywhere? We should never be discouraged - Take it to the Lord in prayer. Can we find a friend so faithful, Who will all our sorrows share? Jesus knows our every weakness; Take it to the Lord in prayer. Are we weak and heavy-laden, Cumbered with a load of care? Precious Savior, still our refuge - Take it to the Lord in prayer.”
confession: I won’t fret or worry. I will let my petitions and praises shape my worries into prayers, letting God know my concerns.

title: : THE LORD IS THINKING OF YOU
body: : THE LORD IS THINKING OF YOU “And be constantly renewed in the spirit of your mind [having a fresh mental and spiritual attitude], And put on the new nature (the regenerate self) created in God's image.” (Amp) Eph 4:23-24 Ponder on verses 17 - 22 of the same chapter, “So this I say and solemnly testify in [the name of] the Lord [as in His presence], that you must no longer live as the heathen (the Gentiles) do in their perverseness [in the folly, vanity, and emptiness of their souls and the futility] of their minds. Their moral understanding is darkened and their reasoning is beclouded.” (Amp). Your mind is the gateway to your destiny and so, you have a grave responsibility from God to constantly get it renewed. Sing: When we walk with the Lord in the light of his Word, What a glory he sheds on our way! While we do his good will, he abides with us still, And with all who will trust and obey. Trust and obey, for there's no other way, To be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey. But we never can prove the delights of his love, Until all on the altar we lay; For the favor he shows, and the joy he bestows, Are for them who will trust and obey.
confession: I take on a new way of life, a Godfashioned life.

title: : BE RENEWED IN THE SPIRIT OF YOUR MIND
verse: to the dividing asunder of soul and spiri.” (KJV)
body: : BE RENEWED IN THE SPIRIT OF YOUR MIND “For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spiri.” (KJV) Heb 4:12 There is nothing on earth more powerful than the Word of God. There has never been and there will never be any person whose words carry authority like God’s Word. “For the Word that God speaks is alive and full of power [making it active, operative, energizing, and effective]; it is sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating to the dividing line of the s breath of life (soul) and [the immortal] spirit, and of joints and marrow [of the deepest parts of our nature], exposing and sifting and analyzing and judging the very thoughts and purposes of the heart” (Amp) Heb 4:12. John R. W. Stott said, “We must allow the Word of God to confront us, to disturb our security, to undermine our complacency and to overthrow our patterns of thought and behavior.” Go extra miles, Study and meditate on the Word. Memorize some portions. And live by the Word - Isa 34:16.
prayer: Father, thank You for the quickening power of Your Word. Let Your Word always prevail over me in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : ALLOWING THE QUICKENING EFFECT OF THE WORD
verse: devil, and he will flee from you” (KJV) James 4:7
body: : ALLOWING THE QUICKENING EFFECT OF THE WORD “Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you” (KJV) James 4:7 To resist means to oppose, withstand, strive against, or fight using spiritual means and weapons. Spiritual resistance is a defensive weapon that shields you from satanic assaults. “Take up God's instruments of war, so that you may be able to keep your position against all the deceits of the Evil One. For our fight is not against flesh and blood, but against authorities and powers, against the world-rulers of this dark night, against the spirits of evil in the heavens. For this reason take up all the arms of God, so that you may be able to be strong in the evil day, and, having done all, to keep your place” (BBE) Eph 6:11-13. It is important to consider the phrase submit yourselves. Your submission is strategic if you must win in the spiritual battle against the devil. You must daily be a man under authority - you must be a man/woman of full obedience, 2 Cor 10:6. Read Eph 4:27.
prayer: Father, I take authority over the devil and his cohorts right now. I cancel all the manipulative power of the enemies over my life in the name above every name, Amen.

title: : RESIST THE DEVIL
verse: himself in the LORD his God” (KJV) 1 Sam 30:6
body: : RESIST THE DEVIL “And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him. but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God” (KJV) 1 Sam 30:6 The devil knows he must steal your joy to defeat you. If David could encourage himself in the Lord, you too can do it. It was bad for David when he returned to his home in Ziklag after a journey and discovered that his enemies, the Amalekites, had destroyed and stolen everything he had. His men even turned against him [1 Sam 30]. Amazing lesson from his life is that David didn’t allow grief to conquer him. David took his harp, retreated, and sang praise to God. David, I believe, never felt like singing, but he did, anyway. On the wings of his songs his spirit was lifted. Through praise and worship, David got back his strength, Ps 27:13-14. Paul and Silas did the same about 1000 years later. They had been arrested for casting a spirit of divination out of a young slave girl. After trial, they’re beaten with rods and imprisoned with their feet in chains. At midnight, they sang and an angelic intervention was the result.
confession: I refuse to give up. No matter the situation around and within me, I’ll always encourage myself in the Lord.

title: 1: ENCOURAGE YOURSELF IN GOD
body: 1: ENCOURAGE YOURSELF IN GOD “For I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ.” (ESV) 1 Cor 2:2 The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts. You can’t give what you don’t possess. You can only give out of the abundance of what you carry. Very little is needed to make a happy life; and that is within your way of thinking. The good you see in yourselves and others is what your thoughts make it. Dwell on others’ good qualities, by so doing you can help lift them from where they are to where God wants them to be. “. Do your best to live in a way that shows you really are God's called and chosen people. If you do all this, you will never fall” (ERV) 2 Pet 1:10. You’re not left in the dark as to how your life should be lived. Consciously cultivate good manner. “And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you” (KJV) Eph 4:32. “Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering.” (KJV) Col 3:12-14.
confession: I choose to always dwell on others’ good qualities. I reject negative mindedness.

title: : DWELL ON OTHERS’ GOOD QUALITIES
verse: called according to his purpose” (KJV) Rom 8:28
body: : DWELL ON OTHERS’ GOOD QUALITIES “And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose” (KJV) Rom 8:28 Facing tests and trials with grace is a life that God wants all His children to develop as they mature spiritually. Reproaches, persecutions, distresses, temptations and challenges are among some of the tests and trials that bring us to perfection. As you allow God to bring about His purposes through these trials, you avoid the trap of resentment. “Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation” (KJV) Hab 3:17-18. In every situation, you should thank Him. It’s in the act of thanksgiving you develop a positive perspective about tests and trials. “In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God.” (KJV) 1 Thes 5:18.
confession: I will do all things without murmurings and disputes: that I may be blameless and harmless, the son of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation.

title: : POSITIVE APPROACH TO TESTS AND TRIALS
verse: has a king as his friend” (GWT) Pro 22:11
body: : POSITIVE APPROACH TO TESTS AND TRIALS “Whoever loves a pure heart. speaks graciously has a king as his friend” (GWT) Pro 22:11 People are the most precious and valuable of all resources. Your achievement, success and fulfilment hang largely on your good interpersonal relationship. The best way to go is to develop appealing, attractive and magnetic character that draw others to you. People are drawn to those who listen, understand, encourage and appreciate them. A careful look at the life of Jesus shows that He was a people person who touched and impacted lives. Treat and regard people as assets whose place is strategic to growth. Be a person people can trust: a confident person, a credible person, a growing person, a problemsolving person and an emphatic person. With these and many more attributes the Holy Spirit would inspire you to develop, you will be on your way to becoming a people person.
confession: I am growing up, by God’s inexhaustible and limitless grace, a better people person. I am committing myself to becoming a listening, understanding and approachable person at home, work place, church and community. My life will reflect Jesus - my Master.

title: : BECOME A PEOPLE PERSON
body: : BECOME A PEOPLE PERSON “. I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things” (KJV) 1 Cor 13:11 Your words are a reflection of who you are. Napoleon Hill said, “Think twice before you speak, because your words and influence will plant the seed of either success or failure in the mind of another.” Your words have amazing and farfetched power. Your words can dissolve doubts or create doubts. Your words can create life or destroy it. Your words can help lift someone or keep someone perpetually in bondage. Ultimately, your words can leave people better or worse than you met them. Plato said, “Wise men speak because they have something to say; Fools because they have to say something.” I leave you with this priceless piece, “Anyone who says he is a Christian but doesn't control his sharp tongue is just fooling himself, and his religion isn't worth much” (TLB) Jam 1:26.
prayer: And so, Dear Lord Jesus, I get rid of all unwise attitude and in a humble [gentle, modest] spirit, I receive and welcome the Word which is implanted in my hearts. I pray that Your Word will prosper me in the precious name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : IT’S THINKING BEFORE TALKING
body: : IT’S THINKING BEFORE TALKING “I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD” (KJV) Ps 118:17 When thought of death comes to knock at the door, respond by the Word, “I shall not die but live, and shall declare the works and recount the illustrious acts of the Lord” (Amp) Ps 118:17. God’s Word is the final! “With long life will [I] be rewarded; and [He] will let [me] see [His] salvation” (BBE) Ps 91:16. The Bible further establishes that, “Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season” (KJV) Job 5:26. Do counter satan’s lies with the established truth of God’s Word. However, remember that you’ve a part to play: don’t be a law breaker. “. fear the LORD your God. keep all His statutes and His commandments. all the days of your life, and that your days may be prolonged” (NKJV) Deut 6:2. Read Ecc 12:13-14. “The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened” (KJV) Pro 10:27.
confession: For by [Him] my days shall be multiplied, And the years of [my] life shall be increased. And [my] age shall be clearer than the noonday; [I] shalt shine forth, [I] shalt be as the morning. God is satisfying me with long life.

title: : ST OP THAT THOUGHT OF DEA TH
body: : ST OP THAT THOUGHT OF DEA TH “Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance” (KJV) 2 Pet 1:13 Negative people could be dangerous to themselves and to those around them. Negative thinking and wrong perspective to life are contrary to a healthy life. No man goes beyond his thoughts. You’re to help transform somebody’s thinking pattern and bring the person to a state where the mind is totally free from negative activities. The first spiritual help to be rendered is to adopt the power of prevailing prayers. “The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will”(KJV) Pro 21:1. There is no one whose God’s omnipotent hand can not reach. Battle over the souls of men in your closest. Approach the individual with a friendly spirit - not with a critical or judgmental spirit - you don’t win someone’s heart by condemning the person. Allow the Holy Spirit to put the right words in your mouth. Transforming life is not a day work. Let God keep ordering your steps to know the next thing to do.
prayer: Father, I promise to step into the ministry of transforming lives in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : HELP TRANSFORM SOMEBODY’S THINKING
verse: shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon” (KJV) Ps 92:12
body: : HELP TRANSFORM SOMEBODY’S THINKING “The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon” (KJV) Ps 92:12 God wants you to grow like a cedar in Lebanon [a tall evergreen tree prized for its high quality timber, oils and resins; used in building Solomon’s temple, as well as the ships and temples of the Egyptian pharaohs]. Growth is not automatic; you’ve to go strategic to experience real growth. “But grow in spiritual strength and become better acquainted with our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be all glory and splendid honor.” (TLB) 2 Pet 3:18. “For this very reason, adding your diligence [to the divine promises], employ every effort in exercising your faith to develop virtue (excellence, resolution, Christian energy), and in [exercising] virtue [develop] knowledge (intelligence), And in [exercising] knowledge [develop] self-control, and in [exercising] self-control [develop] steadfastness (patience, endurance), and in [exercising] steadfastness [develop] godliness (piety).” (Amp) 2 Pet 1:3-8. Growth is a must. Think it and work it out!
prayer: Dear Lord, I pray that I might be diligent enough to be strategic in working out my growth in You in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : THINK GROWTH
body: : THINK GROWTH “We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves” (KJV) Rom 15:1 Life’s purpose is defined by your contribution in making life a better one. You have only one life, make it count. “Therefore, my beloved brethren, be firm (steadfast), immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord [always being superior, excelling, doing more than enough in the service of the Lord], knowing and being continually aware that your labor in the Lord is not futile [it is never wasted or to no purpose]” (Amp) 1 Cor 15:58. Do whatever you can, wherever you are, whenever you can, for as long as you can with whatever you have in bringing joy to everyone. Everybody is standing, but you must stand out. Everybody is on the go, but you must go extra miles! Everybody is doing something, but you must do something extraordinary. The purpose of life is not to be happy; it’s to be useful, helpful and make a difference, Isa 58:10.
prayer: Sweet Holy Spirit, I’m so excited with Your Word fired into my spirit. I ask for Your divine assistance in this noble ministry of reaching out in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : REACH OUT. HELP SOMEONE
body: : REACH OUT. HELP SOMEONE “Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal” (KJV) Rev 21:11 Heaven is a place of unspeakable glory where the elects of God will live from eternity to eternity. The exceeding glory of this beautiful city far outweighs the glory of all earthly kingdoms put together. Our imaginations can never grasp its encompassing glory! Its beauty beats human comprehension. Its glory remains unfathomable by human calculation. “. but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him: And they shall see his face. And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever” (KJV) Rev 22:1-5. If you’re a true believer, you belong to Christ. God is the ultimate King! And we all shall dwell together. Pray that you’ll partake of the awaiting weight of God’s glory, Rev 21:8. If you must miss any place, never miss heaven.
prayer: 1. Thank God 2. Confess sinful practices that could prevent you from making heaven 3. Promise God to maintain a consistent walk with Him. [Hymn: When the Roll is Called up Yonder]

title: : THE BEAUTY OF THAT BEAUTIFUL CITY
body: : THE BEAUTY OF THAT BEAUTIFUL CITY “. and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work.” [KJV] Rev 22:12 How sweet to know that all our services and labour of love are not for nothing. He’s on the way. He’ll soon be here to pay us - all in full. “Yes, I'm on my way! I'll be there soon! I'm bringing my payroll with me. I'll pay all people in full for their life's work” [TBCL] Rev 22:12. “Whatever may be your task, work at it heartily (from the soul), as [something done] for the Lord and not for men, 24 Knowing [with all certainty] that it is from the Lord. that you will receive the inheritance which is your [real] reward. [The One Whom] you are actually serving [is] the Lord.” [Amp] Col 3:23-24. Nothing goes unnoticed by God. Even a cup of cold water, “And if you give even a cup of cold water to one of the least of my followers, you will surely be rewarded” [NLT] Matt 10:42. Our services may differ, but to ONE Lord we serve, 1 Cor 3:8. 1 Cor 15:58 says, “. stand your ground. And don't hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort” [TBCL].
confession: I’ll continually do the work of the Lord and my work shall be rewarded [Repeat it].

title: : NOT FOR NOTHING
body: : NOT FOR NOTHING “. So wherever you go in the world, tell everyone the Good News” (GWT) Mark 16:15 P. F. Bresee said, “We are debtors to every man to give him the gospel in the same measure in which we have received it.” Your assignment is clear and specific. One part of it is your responsibility to other Christians and the other is your unique responsibility to the lost sinners. Jesus, when on earth fulfilled His divine assignment to the letter. At 12, he was about His Father’s business. At 33, He has finished what He was ordained to do, John 20:21. The work of evangelism begins where you are - in your Jerusalem - and to other parts of the world. “God is pursuing with omnipotent passion a worldwide purpose of gathering joyful worshipers for Himself from every tribe and tongue and people and nation. He has an inexhaustible enthusiasm for the supremacy of His name among the nations. let us bring our affections into line with His. let us renounce the quest for worldly comforts and join His global purpose.”
confession: Father, let my heart be broken with the things that break Your heart. Create fire in my bones. Set my spirit ablaze for You in Jesus’ name, Amen. [Hymn: Must I Go, and Empty-handed?]

title: : THINK WORLD EV ANGELIZA TION
body: : THINK WORLD EV ANGELIZA TION “I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me” (KJV) Phil 4:13 It’s great reading the Amplified version of Phil 4:13, “I have strength for all things in Christ Who empowers me [I am ready for anything and equal to anything through Him Who infuses inner strength into me; I am self-sufficient in Christ's sufficiency].” Declare to yourself: I have God-kind of Strength for all things - full of power and might to accomplish all that I am destined to do - Christ is my empowerment. I am equal to anything, anytime, any day through Christ who infuses His divine ability in me. I am self-sufficient in Christ’s sufficiency - I don’t operate by natural ability - His supernatural ability is at work in me and through me. I’m supernaturally endowed. No matter your career or profession, possibility thinking can help broaden your horizon. Greatness isn’t reserved for some special few. Greatness is accessible - within reach - for everyone who desperately wants it. Nothing is impossible. “Whatever I have, wherever I am, I can make it through anything in the One who makes me who I am” (TBCL) 2 Cor 12:9.
prayer: Father, I am grateful for this teaching, I go forward with this fresh insight, Amen.

title: : YES, YOU CAN!
body: : YES, YOU CAN! “. to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly.” (KJV) Rom 12:3 Pride is a major hindrance to growth. Proud people don’t grow, only humble people do. Real growth begins with true humility. “For by the grace (unmerited favor of God) given to me I warn everyone among you not to estimate and think of himself more highly than he ought [not to have an exaggerated opinion of his own importance], but to rate his ability with sober judgment, each according to the degree of faith apportioned by God to him” (Amp). “I'm speaking to you out of deep gratitude for all that God has given me, and especially as I have responsibilities in relation to you. Living then, as every one of you does, in pure grace” (TBCL). To think soberly about yourself means to understand yourself from God’s own perspective only - no exaggerated view - neither do you make a mountain out of a molehill. “For it is God who worketh in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure” (KJV) Phil 2:13.
confession: I submit to the will of God. I will always think soberly. No exaggerated view of myself.

title: : THINK SOBERL Y
body: : THINK SOBERL Y “. forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye” (KJV) Col 3:13 “I can forgive, but I cannot forget” says Henry Ward Beecher, “is only another way of saying, I will not forgive. Forgiveness ought to be like a cancelled note - torn in two, and burned up, so that it never can be shown against one.” That’s exactly what it means to forgive from the heart. Going through the Scriptures, Esau forgave Jacob [Gen 33:4, 11], Joseph forgave his brothers [Gen 45:5-15; 50:19-21], David forgave Saul [1 Sam 24;10-12; 26:9], Solomon forgave Adonijah [1 Kings 1:53] and Jesus forgave His enemies [Luke 23:34]. Learn to forgive and always make a deliberate choice to allow God have His way no matter the magnitude of the offence, Matt 6:14-15. People who won’t forgive wrongs at work, office or church grow increasingly bitter. The call, sometimes, to forgive is a call to hard work. But that is no excuse in any way. We must forgive so as to unlock closed heavens.
prayer: Dear heavenly Father, I receive grace upon grace to always forgive in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen. [Settle issues with God].

title: : FORGIVING FROM YOUR HEAR T
body: : FORGIVING FROM YOUR HEAR T “For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones” (KJV) Eph 5:30 How sweet to sing and pray, “1. God give us Christian homes! Homes where the Bible is loved and taught, Homes where the Master's will is sought, Homes crowned with beauty Your love has wrought; God give us Christian homes; God give us Christian homes! 2. God give us Christian homes! Homes where the father is true and strong, Homes that are free from the blight of wrong, Homes that are joyous with love and song; God give us Christian homes; God give us Christian homes! God give us Christian homes! 3. Homes where the mother, in caring quest, Strives to show others Your way is best, Homes where the Lord is an honored guest; God give us Christian homes; God give us Christian homes! The most significant aspect of a building is the foundation and that’s true when it comes to building a Christian home. Jesus must be the foundation of every home, Matt 7:24-25. Homes must be built on mutual trust, understanding and sacrifice - Eph 5:32-33.
prayer: Father, I receive Your help in playing my part. Let Your tranquility, love and togetherness prevail in my home in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : HA VE YOUR HOME IN YOUR THOUGHT
verse: you do, you won't be given your full reward” (CEV)
body: : HA VE YOUR HOME IN YOUR THOUGHT “So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward” (CEV) 2 John 1:8 An excellent plan is likened to a road map that shows the final destination. You know what? Planning brings the future into the present so as to maximize every opportunity around you. Proper plans help individuals, leaders and organizations to execute projects, reach their goals, and fulfill their noble visions. “A man who does not plan long ahead will find trouble at his door.” says a Chinese philosopher. If you must go ahead, you must plan ahead. Spiritual, business, marital and economic growth are not spontaneous, they have to be thoroughly planned for and passionately pursued. “For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it? Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him” (KJV) Luke 14:28-29. Read Pro 24:27.
prayer: Father, I receive power for careful planning and execution in the precious name of Jesus, Amen. [Carefully plan your schedules for today. Carry out the same every day.]

title: : ALWAYS PLAN AHEAD
verse: think ye evil in your hearts?” (KJV) Matt 9:4
body: : ALWAYS PLAN AHEAD “. Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?” (KJV) Matt 9:4 Sing it! Hum it! It’s the song of victory! “By the anointing Jesus breaks the yoke; By the Holy Ghost’s power just as the prophets foretold. This is the day of the latter rain, God is moving in His power again; By the anointing Jesus breaks the yoke. It’s not by might; it’s not by power; But by my Spirit, saith the LORD. This mountain shall be removed [3times]. By my Spirit, saith the Lord.” “And it shall come to pass in that day [now is the day], that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder [mind], and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing” (KJV) Isa 10:27. Your total and absolute freedom is now. “Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered? But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered. ” (KJV) Isa 49:24-26.
prayer: 1. Thank God for His power to set free [Read 2 Tim 1:7] 2. Pull down the stronghold of evil thoughts in your mind 3. Cast down every evil imagination in your heart 4. Command your mind to receive divine touch and be free.

title: : DELIVERANCE FROM EVIL THOUGHTS
body: : DELIVERANCE FROM EVIL THOUGHTS “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked” (KJV) Eph 6:16 Nothing, absolutely nothing, works in the Kingdom of God outside the realm of faith. Faith is a principal instrument to quench all the fiery darts - be it fear, attack, sickness, disease, poverty, obstacle and affliction - of the wicked. Faith is not just a mere, superficial mouth confession; it’s a genuine, heartfelt, convincing profession based on the Word. It is not just saying what God says; it is doing and acting on what God says. When real living faith is at work, the power of God goes to work. The three Hebrews won by faith. Daniel conquered by it. “And what shall I say further? For time would fail me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets” [Judg 4:1-5; 6:1-8, 35; 11:1-12, 15; 13:1-16; 1 Sam 1:1-30:31; Acts 3:24]. “Who by [the help of] faith subdued kingdoms, administered justice, obtained promised blessings, closed the mouths of lions.” Heb 11:32-34.
confession: I take upon me God's armour of faith. I subdue all arrows of fear, sickness, poverty and affliction of the wicked.

title: : TAKING THE SHIELD OF F AITH
verse: and become like him in his death” (TEV) Phil 3:10.
body: : TAKING THE SHIELD OF F AITH “All I want is to know Christ and to experience the power of his resurrection, to share in his sufferings and become like him in his death” (TEV) Phil 3:10. We need the revelation of His divine love to do extraordinary exploits both with our lives, resources and everything in our custody. As I ponder on the life of Julian of Norwich of fourteenth Century, who lived a solitary life of prayer and meditation. She was the first woman who wrote the first English literary work: Revelations of Divine Love. As a young woman, she prayed that she would 1. Have the knowledge of Christ's suffering 2. Receive three wounds: the wounds of true repentance, of kind compassion and of longing for God. “. By having the eyes of your heart flooded with light, so that you can know and understand the hope to which He has called you, and how rich is His glorious inheritance in the saints (His set-apart ones), And [so that you can know and understand] what is the immeasurable and unlimited and surpassing greatness of His power in and for us who believe.” (AMP) Eph 1:17-20.
prayer: Jesus, I pray for an uncommon insight that leads to transformation, Amen.

title: : REVELA TION OF HIS DIVINE LOVE
verse: once named among you, as becometh saint”
body: : REVELA TION OF HIS DIVINE LOVE “But fornication, and all uncleanness. let it not be once named among you, as becometh saint” (KJV) Eph 5:3 Here is a solemn command - so explicit, - none can violate it without being exposed to its consequence. “Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body” (KJV) 1 Cor 6:18. There are some sins which a man can resist; some which a man can reason. But this kind, a man is safe only when he runs. Joseph fled [Gen 39:12]. Job made a covenant with his eyes [Job 31:1]. Fornication and all uncleanness defile the body. “But among you there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity.” (NIV). Sexual immorality is forbidden among God’s people. Avoid sexual promiscuity and filthy practices in words and actions. Endeavour to keep the body of Christ clean, Pro 6:26-29. 1 Thes 4:3 says, “For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication.”
confession: Behold, I go in pursuit of purity, safeguarding my heart and life with all diligence. I’ll keep to the standard of the Bible.

title: : THE PURSUIT OF PURITY
body: : THE PURSUIT OF PURITY “Beware that thou forget not the LORD. in not keeping his commandments.” (KJV) Deut 8:11 No matter what, you mustn’t forget Him. In a speech made in 1863, Abraham Lincoln said “We have been the recipients of the choicest bounties of heaven; we have been preserved these many years in peace and prosperity; we have grown in numbers, wealth, and power as no other nation has ever grown. But we have forgotten God. We have forgotten the gracious hand which preserved us in peace and multiplied and enriched and strengthened us, and we have vainly imagined, in the deceitfulness of our hearts, that all these blessings were produced by some superior wisdom and virtue of our own. Intoxicated with unbroken success, we have become too self-sufficient to feel the necessity of redeeming and preserving grace, too proud to pray to the God that made us.” The Christian life is not always easy - there are challenges, temptations and trials. In spite of all these, we must not, as a matter of necessity, forget our God nor neglect our faith in Him - John 15:1-2.
prayer: Dear loving Father, I heartily promise not to forget You in Jesus precious name, Amen.
